data.description_suggestion: Retrieves a comprehensive reference list of all possible shipment statuses in the InPost logistics system. Returns a mapping of status codes to their descriptions, including lifecycle statuses (created, confirmed, delivered), operational statuses (dispatched_by_sender, taken_by_courier, out_for_delivery), exception statuses (missing, claimed, oversized), and terminal statuses (returned_to_sender, canceled). This reference is essential for interpreting tracking information and understanding shipment state transitions. No parameters required. Use this operation to build status lookup tables or validate status values received from tracking queries.
